title: Pod built with warnings suppressed
description: Podfile declares a pod that hides compiler warnings. A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a pod that hides compiler warnings.
remediation: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix a pod that hides compiler warnings.
limitation: It matches a pod that hides compiler warnings in the parsed Podfile; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
